result.reason: The added operative language reaches the preferred position: up to six months of reasonable transition assistance at Licensor’s then-current rates, return of Licensee data within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and subsequent deletion with written certification. It leaves the original termination provisions intact and changes no more than necessary. Drafting is professional, though it could more precisely set a deadline for deletion and address any limited continued access rights needed to make transition assistance effective after automatic license termination.
